questions.q: The recent survey conducted by the World Health Organization suggests that the number of people suffering from diabetes have increased significantly over the last decade.
o: suggests that the number of people
questions.s: Concept samjho, ratta nahi! 'The number of' ke baad Noun Plural aata hai lekin Verb hamesha *Singular* hoti hai. 'A number of' ke saath plural verb aati hai. Yahan 'The number' hai, toh 'Has increased' aayega.

questions.q: Not only the students but also the class teacher were present in the auditorium when the principal announced the new regulations.
o: but also the class teacher were
questions.s: Subject-Verb Agreement ka classic rule! Jab do subjects 'Not only... but also' se jude hon, toh Verb *nearest subject* (second subject) ke hisaab se aati hai. Teacher singular hai, toh 'Was' aayega.

questions.q: Despite the fact that the government has launched several schemes for the upliftment of the poor, the ground reality remains that many a poor are still deprived of basic amenities.
questions.s: Ye rule dimaag mein chap lo! 'Many a' ke baad Noun aur Verb dono *Singular* hote hain. 'Many a poor is' sahi hoga. (Meaning plural hota hai, par structure singular).

questions.q: The Board of Directors want the facilities to be improved immediately so that the employees can work more efficiently.
questions.s: Collective Noun Trap! 'Board of Directors' ek single body hai jo ek decision le rahi hai. Jab group united ho, toh Verb *Singular* aati hai. 'The Board... wants' sahi hoga.

questions.q: It is strictly prohibited to carry any inflammable items such as matches, lighters, or fireworks into the premise of the airport.
questions.s: Confusing Word! 'Premise' ka matlab 'Tark/Logic' hota hai. Building/Parisar ke liye hamesha 'Premises' (Plural form) use hota hai. 'Into the premises' sahi hai.

questions.q: One of the major drawbacks of the new educational policy is that it does not focus on the personality developments of the students.
questions.s: Abstract Noun Error! 'Personality Development' ek concept/process hai jo uncountable sense mein use hota hai. 'Developments' bolna galat hai. 'Personality development' sahi hoga.

questions.q: The astronomer who predicts the future has arrived at the conference to give a lecture on the movement of stars.
questions.s: Vocabulary Blunder! 'Astronomer' scientist hota hai jo stars study karta hai. Jo bhavishya batata hai wo 'Astrologer' hota hai. Context dekho: 'Predicts the future' likha hai, toh 'Astrologer' aayega.

questions.q: All the chiefs ministers of the various states were invited to the meeting held at the Prime Minister's residence.
questions.s: Compound Noun Pluralization! Jab Post + Designation ho, toh plural *Main Word* ka banta hai. 'Chief' adjective hai, 'Minister' noun hai. Sahi plural: 'Chief Ministers'.

questions.q: I have read many plays of Shakespeare but I found 'As You Like It' to be the best among all his works.
o: found 'As You Like It' to be
the best among all his works
questions.s: No Error. Yahan 'Works' ka matlab 'literary creations' (rachnayein) hai, jo ki countable plural hai. Agar 'kaam' (labor) matlab hota toh 'work' aata. Context literary hai, toh sahi hai.

questions.q: Whenever he goes to Mumbai on official tours, he stays in five-stars hotels because he wants maximum comfort.
questions.s: Hyphenated Adjective Rule! Jab Noun (star) adjective ki tarah act kare (hyphen ke baad), toh wo singular rehta hai. 'Five-star hotels' sahi hoga.

questions.q: The police has received important information regarding the murder case that happened in the city last week.
questions.s: Double Concept! 1. Police Plural hai -> 'Have' aayega. 2. Information Uncountable hai -> Singular rahega. Error part A mein hai: 'The police have received'.

questions.q: There are only a few company who can handle projects of this magnitude efficiently without compromising on quality.
questions.s: Quantifier Rule! 'A few' ke baad Noun hamesha *Plural* aata hai. 'A few companies' sahi hoga.

questions.q: The sceneries of the Himalayas are so enchanting that tourists from all over the world come to visit them every year.
questions.s: Noun Constraint! 'Scenery' uncountable hai, iska plural nahi banta. Sahi sentence: 'The scenery of the Himalayas is...' (Verb bhi singular hogi).

questions.q: He acted not as per my advice but somebody else.
questions.s: Comparison Consistency! 'My advice' (possessive) ka comparison 'Somebody else's (advice)' se hona chahiye. Apostrophe missing hai. Sahi: 'Somebody else's'.

questions.q: The committee could not come to a final conclusion because it was divided in their opinion regarding the budget distribution.
questions.s: Pronoun-Verb Mismatch! Agar committee 'divided' hai, toh wo Plural ban gayi. 'It was' ki jagah 'They were' aana chahiye kyunki aage 'their opinion' bhi use hua hai.

questions.q: One of the problem with you is that you do not utilize your time efficiently and then blame others for your failure.
questions.s: Grammar Bible! 'One of the' ke baad aane wala Noun hamesha *Plural* hota hai. 'One of the problems' sahi hai.

questions.q: The manager put forward a number of criterions for the post but none of the candidates fulfilled them.
questions.s: Foreign Plural! 'Criterion' singular hai, 'Criteria' plural hai. 'Criterions' koi word nahi hota. 'A number of criteria' sahi hai.

questions.q: More than one student have been shortlisted for the scholarship based on their academic performance.
questions.s: Tricky Subject! 'More than one + Singular Noun' ke saath Verb hamesha *Singular* aati hai. 'Has been shortlisted' sahi hoga. (Agar 'More students than one' hota toh plural aata).

questions.q: If you are going to the market, do not forget to bring a bunch of grapes and two dozens bananas.
questions.s: Numeral Adjective! 'Dozen' se pehle number (Two) hai, toh Dozen singular rahega. 'Two dozen bananas' sahi hai.

questions.q: The cattle in the meadow was terrified to hear the roar of a lion which appeared suddenly from the bushes.
questions.s: Plural Noun! 'Cattle' plural hai. Iske saath singular verb 'was' nahi aa sakti. 'Were terrified' sahi hoga.

questions.q: She has misplaced her spectacle and is now facing difficulty in reading the fine print of the document.
questions.s: Noun Pair! Chashme ko 'Spectacles' (plural) kehte hain. 'Spectacle' ka matlab nazara hota hai. 'Her spectacles' sahi hai.

questions.q: It is harmful to take cupsful of tea five times a day because excess caffeine can cause health issues.
questions.s: Compound Plural! '-ful' ending words ka plural 's' end mein lagake banta hai. 'Cupsful' galat hai, 'Cupfuls' sahi hai.

questions.q: The first inning of the match was very sensational and the spectators enjoyed every moment of it.
questions.s: Sports Terminology! Cricket mein 'Innings' hamesha 's' ke saath likha jata hai, chahe wo first ho ya second. 'First innings' sahi hai.

questions.q: Language consists of several stratums, said a linguist in his lecture on Language and Linguistics.
questions.s: Latin/Greek Plural! 'Stratum' singular hai, 'Strata' plural hai. 'Stratums' galat word hai.

questions.q: The jury was divided in their opinion regarding the verdict of the case which led to a delay in justice.
questions.s: Collective Noun Division! Jab Jury divide ho gayi hai (alag-alag opinion), toh wo Plural ban gayi. 'The jury were divided' sahi hoga.
